Table R1.title: Frozen A-H experiment inventory and analysis rules.
Table R1.note: Task and physical-simulation counts, validity, biological rhythmic failure, pulse delivery, and the locked comparison unit are reported separately for each stage. Counts and summaries are conditional on one frozen stochastic realization. Design cells, tasks, routes, and reused simulation identifiers are not independent replicates.

Table R2.title: Intact-network phase stability and pulse-recovery summary.
Table R2.note: The nine no-pulse descending-drive-by-load cells are exact values. The low/medium/high field is an input command, not measured locomotor speed. Active-pulse phase effects are post-pulse minus direction-matched sham; recovery eligibility, event status, and observed times are separate fields. Counts and summaries are conditional on one frozen stochastic realization. Design cells, tasks, routes, and reused simulation identifiers are not independent replicates.

Table R3.title: Context-matched single and paired intervention effects.
Table R3.note: No-pulse rows use whole-run phase endpoints and active-pulse rows use post-pulse endpoints. Pair nonadditivity is pair - single 1 - single 2 + intact. Medians and ranges summarize nine prespecified descending-drive-by-load cells. Counts and summaries are conditional on one frozen stochastic realization. Design cells, tasks, routes, and reused simulation identifiers are not independent replicates.

Table R4.title: Effects of ten presynaptic route impairments.
Table R4.note: Each route is compared with its exact intact descending-drive-by-load-by-pulse reference. Functional phase, propagation, biological failure/recovery, and terminal-state changes are kept distinct. Counts and summaries are conditional on one frozen stochastic realization. Design cells, tasks, routes, and reused simulation identifiers are not independent replicates.

Table R5.title: Class-by-route marginal effects and exact nonadditivity.
Table R5.note: All 10-by-10 class-route cells are reported for each pulse. Continuous summaries remain blank where the required rhythmic arms are unavailable; blank values are not recoded as neutral. Counts and summaries are conditional on one frozen stochastic realization. Design cells, tasks, routes, and reused simulation identifiers are not independent replicates.

Table R6.title: Composite-stress and terminal-support/KCa mechanism controls.
Table R6.note: Stage G uses exact challenge-by-impairment differences-in-differences by locked window. Stage H reports dynamic-minus-terminal-support controls, KCa-control-minus-dynamic-KCa contrasts, and their exact differences-in-differences. Recovery and rhythmic failure remain separate from continuous phase effects. Counts and summaries are conditional on one frozen stochastic realization. Design cells, tasks, routes, and reused simulation identifiers are not independent replicates.
